rawContent: I’m so proud of the indomitable  @MHoechstetter and @EvelynYang and all the brave survivors of Robert Hadden who came forward to expose his abuse. I hope every victim of his predation feels some degree of relief now that he has been convicted and held accountable. #MeToo

@susie_parker @CraveCanada Thank you @susie_parker for sharing this, and thank you @CraveCanada for making the @OnTheRecordDoc available to a new audience. I’m so grateful to be part of this film centering survivors, exposing predators, and exploring the intersection of sexual violence and race. #MeToo

I turned off Video auto-play to protect my spirit. Sending love to the family of #TyreNichols 
#BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/CgVCbPnQLM

We must address white supremacy and structural racism, but we must also face the rage it produces. Far too often, with no healthy outlet, that rage is unleashed on Black women, children, queer people and on beautiful brothers like #TyreNichols #BlackLivesMatter #AbolishThePolice

So many Tweets in the Drafts because I don’t know where to begin, so I’m highlighting the courage and words of these brave women instead. #MeToo #Grammys Music Industry Sexual Assault Survivors Attend MusiCares Gala – The Hollywood Reporter https://t.co/IXYGuOJTXI

#MeToo  remains a powerful force for justice, because survivors who live with pain, even when our stories disappear from the headlines, will continue to call out the abuse of sexual predators who once seemed invincible. There is no turning back.  #RKelly #HarveyWeinstein

Thank you @HerstoryK @IHTRT01 for calling out judicial nominee, Michael Delaney, who used DARVO tactics (Deny, Attack, Reverse Victim & Offender) against survivor @Chessy_Prout. This appointment is an insult to the #MeToo movement and betrays all survivors who supported @JoeBiden

Why is Mariska Hargitay of @lawandordertv SVU, who founded @TheJHF (chaired by @debbiemillman) to "transform society’s response to sexual assault" smiling with Russell Simmons, an unrepentant violent serial rapist? This image sends a chilling message to all survivors.  #MeToo

Survivors lose faith in orgs like @TheJHF and @TIMESUPNOW when their leaders enable sexual predators who happen to be celebrities or powerful politicians. Hargitay chose to fight rapists, so if you think it's rude for her to step out of a photo, rape is so much ruder. #MeToo

@annabel_ross @lawandordertv @TheJHF @debbiemillman Yes, it’s possible that she didn’t know Russell Simmons was in the photo at the time, but now that’s it’s been posted and @UncleRUSH has been tagged, Hargitay should make a statement as the founder of @TheJHF so that #MeToo survivors know her organization and commitment is real.

@CeeVonDee @lawandordertv @TheJHF @debbiemillman Yep, and now that Hargitay, the founder of @TheJHF, has presumably seen the photo, she can make a statement so rape victims know she’s a trustworthy advocate. Or she can say nothing and carry on being a terrific actress who has zero credibility in the #MeToo movement. Her choice.

@knockonMCWOODS I loved that show, too. I think as a survivor, I found it comforting. But no more. It’s such a disappointment. So many disappointments since saying #MeToo to be honest, but the good news is I liberated myself from protecting my abusers. And freedom is a beautiful thing.
